blocks.text: Create operation database table mein naya data dalta hai, jaise naam, values ya records. Is ke liye SQL INSERT commands istemal hoti hain. Python yeh commands database ko bhejta hai, aur chalne ke baad naye records mehfooz data ka hissa ban jate hain.
INSERT INTO students (ID, Name, Age) VALUES (1, 'John', 20);
blocks.caption: Table 4.1 ki INSERT misal

items: Create = INSERT: table mein naya record.
